lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible on the mid-lateral flank, forming a repeating grid pattern posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are observed intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a series of grid-like intersection points across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible running longitudinally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and a shadow effect on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A cluster of dark, vertical linear features resembling physical trauma or superficial scarring is visible posterior to the fifth gill slit and superior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple high-contrast, elongated silhouettes of commensal fish (Remora sp.) are visible in the immediate water column adjacent to the shark's pectoral and ventral surfaces.
